errors.COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE: This action is not available yet in this version.
errors.NOT_IN_TAURI: This only works inside the squeezegram desktop app.
errors.IPC_ERROR: The app core refused the request.
errors.IO_ERROR: A disk read or write failed.
errors.DB_ERROR: The queue database reported an error.
errors.SETTINGS_INVALID: These settings were refused as invalid.
errors.ITEM_STARTED: This item has already started and can no longer be changed.
errors.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: This action is not possible in the item's current state.
errors.FILE_UNREADABLE: A file can't be read or is not a regular file.
errors.FFMPEG_MISSING: ffmpeg is not installed, or the custom ffmpeg folder doesn't contain ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe.
errors.FFMPEG_ENCODER_UNAVAILABLE: No video encoder passed its test on this computer.
errors.FFMPEG_FAILED: ffmpeg failed while processing this file.
errors.FFMPEG_FAILED_fallback_failed: The GPU encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped after {{duration}} (exit code {{exitCode}}), and the CPU encoder ({{fallback}}) failed too. Retry this file. If it fails again, set Settings › Encoding › Encoder to “Processor first”.
errors.FFMPEG_FAILED_no_cpu_encoder: The GPU encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped after {{duration}} without finishing (exit code {{exitCode}}), and no CPU encoder works with this ffmpeg to take over. Retry, ideally while no game or screen recording uses the graphics card, or use an ffmpeg that includes libx264.
errors.ENCODER_FALLBACK: The GPU encoder ({{from}}) reported an error after {{duration}}. squeezegram switched to the CPU encoder ({{to}}) and keeps using it until the app restarts.
errors.ENCODER_FALLBACK_silent: The GPU encoder ({{from}}) stopped without an error message (after {{duration}}). squeezegram switched to the CPU encoder ({{to}}) and keeps using it until the app restarts.
errors.OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE: This file can't fit under the upload limit, even compressed.
errors.DISK_SPACE: Not enough free space in the temporary folder.
errors.SIDECAR_CHECKSUM: The downloaded ffmpeg doesn't match the expected checksum, so it was not installed.
errors.SIDECAR_DOWNLOAD: The ffmpeg download failed. Check your connection and resume: it continues where it stopped.
errors.SIDECAR_EXTRACT: The ffmpeg archive couldn't be extracted.
errors.SIDECAR_BUSY: An ffmpeg installation is already running.
errors.SIDECAR_INVALID: This folder doesn't hold a working ffmpeg and ffprobe, so it was not used.
errors.UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Couldn't check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UPDATE_NOT_PUBLISHED: No update information is available yet. Try again later.
errors.UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The update couldn't be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UPDATE_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The downloaded update didn't pass its signature check, so it was not installed.
errors.UPDATE_INSTALL_FAILED: The update couldn't be installed. Your current version is unchanged.
errors.TG_NETWORK: Can't reach Telegram. Check your connection.
errors.TG_FLOOD_WAIT: Telegram asked to wait {{duration}} before sending again.
errors.TG_SLOWMODE: Slow mode is on in this chat. Wait {{duration}} before sending.
errors.TG_WRITE_FORBIDDEN: You can't post in this chat or topic.
errors.TG_FILE_TOO_LARGE: Telegram refused the file as too large (limit {{size}}).
errors.TG_PAID_MESSAGES: This chat charges {{stars}} Stars per message. squeezegram never pays, so nothing was sent.
errors.TG_BAD_DB_KEY: The local Telegram session can't be opened. Sign in again.
errors.TG_NO_PROGRESS: The upload made no progress for {{duration}}. It keeps trying; cancel it if it stays stuck.
errors.TG_UPLOAD_FAILED: Telegram reported that the upload failed.
errors.TG_LIB_MISSING: The Telegram library (tdjson.dll) is missing or damaged.
errors.TG_NOT_CONFIGURED: This build has no valid Telegram API identity (api_id and api_hash), so it can't connect to Telegram.
errors.TG_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: This Telegram feature is not available yet in this version.
errors.FILES_SKIPPED_one: {{count}} file that is not a video or photo was skipped in this folder.
errors.FILES_SKIPPED_other: {{count}} files that are not videos or photos were skipped in this folder.
errors.TG_WRITE_FORBIDDEN_not_member: You are not a member of this chat.
errors.TG_WRITE_FORBIDDEN_join_required: You must join this chat, or be approved, before posting.
errors.TG_WRITE_FORBIDDEN_banned: You are banned from this chat.
errors.TG_WRITE_FORBIDDEN_restricted: Your account is restricted in this chat.
errors.TG_WRITE_FORBIDDEN_admins_only: Only administrators can post in this chat.
errors.LIC_MALFORMED: This isn't a squeezegram license. Copy the whole license from the bot's message and paste it again.
errors.LIC_UNKNOWN_KID: This license was signed with a key this version of squeezegram doesn't know. Update the app, then try again.
errors.LIC_BAD_SIGNATURE: This license failed its signature check. Copy it again from the bot's message, without changing anything.
errors.LIC_WRONG_ACCOUNT: This license belongs to another Telegram account. Sign in with the account it was bought for.
errors.LIC_NO_ACCOUNT: Sign in to Telegram to check this license.

sidecars.missingTitle: ffmpeg is needed to compress videos
sidecars.missingBody: squeezegram downloads its own copy ({{size}}, LGPL build {{tag}}), checks its SHA-256 and never uses an ffmpeg found in PATH.
sidecars.customInvalid: The custom ffmpeg folder set in Settings doesn't contain ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe.

finder.search: Look for an ffmpeg already installed
finder.searching: Looking in the usual install locations…
finder.intro: Only known install folders and the folders of your PATH are checked, and every result is run once to confirm it works. Nothing is used until you choose it.
finder.none: No usable ffmpeg was found on this computer.
finder.pathNote: Found in your PATH. It is listed only: squeezegram never picks an ffmpeg from PATH by itself.

recommendation.download: Recommended: download the ffmpeg proposed by squeezegram.
recommendation.candidate: Recommended: use the ffmpeg marked below.

finder.unusable: No H.264 encoder works with this ffmpeg: it can't compress videos here.
finder.weakWarning: Only basic CPU encoders work with this ffmpeg.

reason.hw_nvenc: Your PC has an NVIDIA GPU: this ffmpeg drives it.
reason.hw_qsv: Your PC has an Intel GPU: this ffmpeg drives it (Quick Sync).
reason.hw_amf: Your PC has an AMD GPU: this ffmpeg drives it.
reason.cpu_x264: It includes libx264, the best CPU fallback and the most accurate for size targets.
reason.no_working_encoder: No H.264 encoder works with it.
reason.license_gpl: GPL build, fine for local use.
reason.candidate_adds_x264: This ffmpeg includes libx264, which the download doesn't: a better CPU fallback and more accurate sizes.
reason.candidate_adds_hardware: This ffmpeg drives a hardware encoder ({{encoder}}) that the download can't use here.
reason.download_no_candidate: No ffmpeg was found on this computer, so the download is the simplest choice.
reason.download_no_gain: None of the ffmpeg found does more than the download.
reason.download_hardware_tested: The installed download was tested on this PC.
reason.download_hardware_assumed: The download isn't installed yet: its hardware support (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF) is assumed from the pinned build.

finder.gplNote: GPL build. squeezegram doesn't distribute it, it stays on your computer.

drop.overlay: Drop to add to the queue
drop.hint: Drop videos and photos anywhere in this window, or

destination.label: Destination
destination.unavailableBody: The core could not list destinations, so files can't be queued.
destination.empty: No destinations yet. Sign in to Telegram, then refresh the list.

check.warning: You can send here, with a warning.

caption.label: Caption (optional)
caption.hint: Applies to every file of this batch.

queue.running: Running: one file at a time. Pausing takes effect after the current file.
queue.idle: Ready: the files you add are processed automatically.
queue.paused: Paused: nothing is processed until you press Start.

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.body: Drop files anywhere in the window, or browse for them above.

clear.title: Clear the queue?
clear.body: The files you clear leave the queue and their prepared copies are deleted. Your original files are never deleted. A file being processed right now is not touched.

all.label: Clear everything not running
all.hint_one: {{count}} file, including files waiting to be sent. They will not be sent.
all.hint_other: {{count}} files, including files waiting to be sent. They will not be sent.

clear.unconfirmed_one: {{count}} file is marked “Needs check”: it may already have reached Telegram. Clearing removes it without checking.
clear.unconfirmed_other: {{count}} files are marked “Needs check”: they may already have reached Telegram. Clearing removes them without checking.
clear.running_one: {{count}} file is still running and was kept.
clear.running_other: {{count}} files are still running and were kept.

duplicate.body: This file was already sent to this destination. It waits until you confirm.
duplicate.dialogBody: {{name}} was already sent to this destination. Sending it again posts a duplicate message.

watch.body: Found in a watched folder. Nothing is sent without your approval.

waiting.body: Telegram asked to slow down. Nothing was sent; it retries on its own at {{time}}.

unknown.body: The app stopped while this file was uploading. It may or may not have reached Telegram.
unknown.dialogBody: If the first upload did arrive, the chat gets {{name}} twice.
unknown.noCandidate: No matching message found in the chat.
unknown.candidatesTitle: Messages that may be this file

failed.keptHint: The prepared file is kept: retrying doesn't compress it again.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this file?
cancelDialog.body: The work done on {{name}}, including the prepared copy, is discarded. The original file is never touched.

history.title: History
history.description: Sent, failed and unconfirmed files, newest first.

clear.title: Clear the history?
clear.body: This deletes every line of the history, not only the ones shown. The app also uses it to warn you when a file was already sent to the same destination: once it is cleared, files you already sent can be sent again without any warning. The queue and your destinations are not affected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

license.title: License
license.hint: A license unlocks squeezegram Premium for the Telegram account it was bought for. It is checked on this computer, with no network request.
license.unavailable: The license status couldn't be read.

status.pending: A license is saved. Sign in to Telegram to check it: it applies once the account it was bought for is signed in.
status.otherAccount: The saved license is bound to another Telegram account. Sign in with the account it was bought for, or remove it.
status.invalid: The saved license can't be used. {{message}}

input.label: Paste your license
input.hint: The bot sends it in a message. It starts with SQZ1.

license.savedPending: License saved. Sign in to Telegram to check it.
license.buy: Buy a license from @squeezegram_bot on Telegram

remove.title: Remove the license?
remove.body: Premium features stop on this computer. Keep the bot's message: the same license can be activated again.

premium.label: Telegram Premium
premium.hint: “Detect from my account” uses the limit of the signed-in Telegram account: 4000 MB with Premium, 2000 MB without, or while signed out. A custom limit overrides it.
premium.currentUnavailable: The limit applied now could not be read.

custom.label: Custom limit (MB)
custom.hint: Overrides the Premium limit. Leave empty to use it.
custom.error: Enter a whole number of MB, greater than 0.

margin.label: Safety margin (%)
margin.hint: Compressed files aim this far under the limit. 3 % has proven reliable.

prefer.label: Encoder
prefer.hint: If the first kind fails its test, the other one is used. If the graphics card stops in the middle of a compression (a game or a screen recorder using it can cause this), the file is compressed again on the processor. If that keeps happening, choose “Processor first”: slower, but it leaves the graphics card alone.
prefer.gpuFailed: The graphics card encoder ({{encoder}}) stopped during a compression in this session. squeezegram uses the processor until the app restarts, then tries the graphics card again.

advanced.title: Advanced encoding
advanced.locked: Included with squeezegram Premium. Until then, compression uses the automatic values shown here.

resolution.label: Maximum resolution
resolution.hint: Larger videos are scaled down to this size; smaller ones are never enlarged. A higher resolution leaves fewer bits for each pixel under the upload limit.

audio.label: Audio bitrate
audio.hint: A higher bitrate sounds better and takes room from the picture under the upload limit.

send.title: Pauses between sends
send.hint: A random pause in this range follows every send.
send.errorInteger: Enter a whole number of seconds, 0 or more.
send.errorOrder: The minimum can't be more than the maximum.

temp.title: Temporary files
temp.errorInteger: Enter a whole number of GB, 0 or more.

ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg
ffmpeg.hint: A folder with ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe, directly or in bin.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: squeezegram keeps a journal of what it does, for 7 days at most, to help find the cause of a problem. It never contains your phone number, codes, passwords, e-mail address or captions.
diagnostics.exportHint: Saves a .zip file with the recent journal, the versions in use and the latest error codes. Folder names and chats are masked. Nothing is sent anywhere: you choose whether to share it.

kind.installer: Installed with the installer: updates download and install from here.
kind.portable: Portable build: a new version is announced but never installed for you. Download it and replace this folder.

automatic.label: Check automatically
automatic.hint: Looks for a new version on GitHub when the app starts, at most once a day. Only a standard web request is sent: no identifier, no Windows version, no usage data.

banner.title: Update available (version {{version}})
banner.portableHint: This is the portable build: download the new zip and replace this folder.
banner.queueRunning: Pause the queue first: squeezegram closes to install the update.
banner.installing: Installing: squeezegram will close and restart.

recovery.title: Something went wrong
recovery.body: This screen hit an unexpected error. The details were written to the journal; you can export them from Settings, Diagnostics.

connection.title: Telegram connection
connection.testTransport: Test transport: sign-in and sending are simulated, nothing reaches Telegram.
connection.closed: Telegram is not available in this build, so signing in is not possible.
connection.loadError: The sign-in state couldn't be read.

phone.title: Sign in with your phone number
phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: With the country code, for example +33 6 12 34 56 78.

qr.title: Scan this code with Telegram on your phone
qr.body: Open Telegram, then Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device. The code renews on its own.

code.title: Enter the login code
code.label: Code
code.hint: Telegram sent it to your other devices or by SMS.
code.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{duration}}.

email.title: Enter your e-mail address
email.label: E-mail address
email.hint: Telegram uses it to secure your sign-in.

emailCode.title: Enter the code sent to your e-mail
emailCode.label: E-mail code

other.title: Telegram needs another step
other.body: This step ({{step}}) can't be done in squeezegram. Finish it in the official Telegram app, then come back.

ready.title: Signed in
ready.logoutBody: The local session is deleted. You will have to sign in again to send files.

destinations.renameHint: Only shown in squeezegram. Leave empty to use the Telegram name.

topics.show: (press right arrow to show the topics)

destinations.telegramHint: These chats are not in your lists.
destinations.unnamedHint: Chats without a name, often deleted accounts.
